title: Color Polarity
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
Hi all,

Have published a paper on color in mainstream journal, available here for free download:
https://link.springer.com/article/10.10 ... 20-09517-3

It is about Goethe and Newton. Even though I haven't directly referenced Larson, those who know the RS2 research will easily recognize the reciprocity of light and dark, which Bruce and I were discussing for a couple of years. It is full of RS2 without one mentioning it by name!

Hope you find this a useful contribution.
It is more useful than other posts related to esoterica and numerology.
